final: WITH trans_values AS (SELECT t.account_id, d.A3 as region, CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount ELSE NULL END as signed_amount FROM trans t JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id), groups AS (SELECT account_id, region, COUNT(*) as row_count, SUM(signed_amount) as group_sum FROM trans_values GROUP BY account_id, region), overall AS (SELECT SUM(group_sum) as total_sum FROM groups WHERE group_sum IS NOT NULL) SELECT g.account_id, g.region, g.group_sum, g.row_count, CAST(g.group_sum AS REAL) / o.total_sum as quotient FROM groups g CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE o.total_sum IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CASE WHEN quotient IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, quotient DESC LIMIT 10
